submitted.description: the original model ask was submitted for a paid generation; an uncertain acknowledgement still counts as submitted

at.description: recorded before the paid request, guarded against any prior submission

name.description: what the provider is called; the entity id is derived from it

transport.description: how its models are reached: `process` is a command line this host runs, `http` an API it calls, `machine` another machine's own providers, asked one step at a time

machine.description: the machine whose providers answer, where `transport` is `machine`; a row naming none is served by nobody

base.description: where a provider reached over HTTP answers: its root URL, without a path

api.description: the API it speaks, which names the code that reaches it: over HTTP, `ollama`, or `openai` for an OpenAI-compatible one; for a `process`, the CLI whose command line it takes and whose stream it prints (`claude`, `codex`), its own name where it names none

command.description: the program a `process` provider is run as, in place of its CLI's own: a name on the PATH or a path. It is given the command line of the CLI named in `api` and prints that CLI's stream

recorded.description: its runs play recordings (packages/spawn/standin.ts), so how one ends is chosen: an ending that is not clean is written on the session, and no failure is reported of it

context.description: the context window, in tokens, assumed for a model it serves whose own row names none

cache_retention.description: documented cached-prefix retention in seconds for this provider’s configured endpoint and models; used from request start only when the answer has no explicit expiry. Missing means unknown

stall_timeout.description: how long, in seconds, a stream from this provider may go without progress before its request fails as stalled; 0 for no limit. Missing means the default, five minutes

plan.description: the provider whose plan limits (`rate_limit`) its requests spend, where they are not its own: `openai` signed in with a ChatGPT grant spends the plan `codex` reports

name.description: the model's own name; the entity id is derived from it

modalities.description: the outputs requested when this model is asked

effort.description: the reasoning effort requested, unless a session overrides it

context.description: the model's context window, in tokens: the most one request holds, its input and reply together; read from its provider's catalog, or set by hand. A transcript is compacted at a share of it

output.description: the model's maximum reply length in tokens, including reasoning, as its provider's catalogue lists it

enforced.description: the token ceiling explicitly enforced by a provider refusal, separate from the configured context window; compaction uses the smaller of them

serves.description: an edge relation: this provider serves that model

name.description: what the provider calls the model, sent as the model of every request it serves

routes.description: an edge relation, from a row whose `using` is a default to an offering (a `serves` edge): the default is chosen among the offerings it routes, the pinned one, else the one whose plan has the most usage left, and its own `using` answers only where none is pinned and no plan has a reading

pinned.description: when this offering was pinned: while the mark is set the default is this offering whatever the plans read, and removing it resumes routing

usage.description: provider-reported token counts for one completed model request, stored on the entry for that request; not cumulative, and not an estimate of current context size

input_tokens.description: input context tokens, including cached tokens

total_tokens.description: total input and output tokens reported by the provider

cached_tokens.description: input tokens read from the provider cache; not a guarantee of future cache availability

cache_write_tokens.description: input tokens written to the provider cache by this request, within input_tokens

cache_write_1h_tokens.description: of the cache writes, those kept an hour rather than minutes, which a provider can price higher

web_searches.description: web searches the provider ran for the request, each billed at the model's web_search price

price.description: what a model costs, in dollars per million tokens and per web search, on the model's own row; a request its provider reports no dollars for is weighed at it

output.description: dollars per million output tokens, reasoning included

cached.description: dollars per million input tokens read from the provider cache; the input price where absent

cache_write.description: dollars per million input tokens written to the provider cache; the input price where absent

cache_write_1h.description: dollars per million input tokens written to the cache for an hour; the cache_write price where absent

web_search.description: dollars per web search the provider runs for a request

cost.description: what one model request or tool call cost, in dollars, on the entity that spent it: a request's entry beside its `usage`, or a call

reported.description: true when the provider reported the dollars; false when they were weighed from the model's `price`

account.description: an account a provider's CLI keeps on this machine: the config directory it signs in from and keeps its transcripts in (`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, `CODEX_HOME`). Each has a plan of its own

home.description: the account's directory, `/Users/erik/.claude-work`; the entity id is derived from it

provider.description: the provider whose CLI keeps it

rate_limit.description: how much of a plan limit is used: one row per provider, window, account and, for a limit on one model, model, holding its latest reading

provider.description: the provider whose plan it is

window.description: the limit's window in minutes: 10080 for a week, 300 for five hours

account.description: the account whose plan it is, where the reading came from one: a transcript or a run of that account, its status line, or a native session's request it answered

model.description: the model whose requests it meters, where it is a limit on one model and not on the whole plan: Claude's weekly cap on Fable

used.description: percent of the window's limit used, as the provider reported it

stream_item.description: the provider-neutral identity of a streamed text item, retained on its output entry for completed-result recovery

model_result.description: a complete provider reply and its provider marks on the original ask, saved before billing settlement and transcript delivery so either can recover without generation

body.description: the completed ModelResult, including usage and known cost; absent cost remains unknown

response.description: what a provider answered a model request that failed, as it arrived, kept beside the line recording the failure so the failure can be read rather than reconstructed; never the request's credentials

body.description: the body of an error status, or the event that ended the stream, as sent

headers.description: the headers that speak of the provider's limits (retry-after, rate limits, plan usage), by lowercase name

questions.description: typed questions about the transcript, asked with the next request and answered by one `answer` entry each rather than in prose

asked.description: each question by its name, in Jev's terms: {type: noul, choice or score, instructions, criteria}

answer.description: a model's answer to one typed question, in the terms it was asked in

question.description: the name of the question it answers

noul.description: for a noul, the probability that it holds

choice.description: for a choice, the option chosen

score.description: for a score, where along its criteria the answer falls

confidence.description: how sure the model is of a choice or a score, from 0 to 1

probabilities.description: each option's probability, by the option's name or place

inference.description: the pinned executor and private frozen request and completed receipt references for the original model ask

executor.description: the independently deployed executor release that accepted this ask

receipt.description: private completed receipt object reference; absent while pending
